source_caption_text:
Polo G really went crazy on this 😮‍💨🔥

Polo G, Stunna 4 Vegas and NLE Choppa came together for “Go Stupid,” with Mike WiLL Made-It and Tay Keith handling the production. The song is straight energy from the start, with all three rappers bringing their own style over the bouncing beat.

Polo G’s verse is especially memorable. He comes in with a faster, more aggressive flow than the melodic style he was known for around the D*e a Legend era, and somehow manages to make the Peja Stojaković line work.

The music video keeps that same energy, with the three rappers going crazy around a high school setting. “Go Stupid” dropped in 2020 and ended up peaking at No. 60 on the Billboard Hot 100, becoming one of the standout songs from that period.
